native_start.null_meaning: Explicit empty authored ledger, not missing/TBD ancestry. First admitted event establishes root/head; no historical parent inferred.
native_start.selection_oracle: CHECK/COLLECT have equal (0,0,0) coverage and no information metric. Admitted policy class priority ranks DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION ahead of SOURCE_ACQUISITION; after CHECK only COLLECT is eligible, then PREPARE becomes ready but remains unexecuted.
